jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Data Integrations)
jobs.description:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

Every investigation starts with data. As PM for the Integration team, you make sure analysts in law enforcement and defense have the data they need, when they need it. You own the roadmap for integrating data from commercial vendors, open feeds, social media and messaging platforms, as well as the admin interfaces used to manage these integrations. Your work ensures data arrives current, traceable to its source and ready to use.

This is a largely technical PM role with significant ownership over a platform and admin experience that are still taking shape. You decide what gets built and in what order, working closely with engineers and other product teams to turn provider APIs and data models into scalable integrations and features that support analysts’ investigations. You’ll read API documentation, map provider data to OIP’s data model and write clear, actionable specs that engineers can build from.

What you'll do

  • Own the provider roadmap. We add a source when it answers a question analysts can’t answer today, so you start from the analyst’s problem, not from a provider’s name. You talk regularly with analysts, admins and solutions engineers in law enforcement and defense, and with the upstream teams whose features bring integration requests. You decide which providers come next and what “done” means for each.
  • Write the technical specs. Cover authentication, pagination, rate limits and quotas, incremental sync, deduplication, field mapping, and how failures surface. Every object must carry its provider, fetch time and source URL from the moment it is fetched. Our platform runs as SaaS and on-prem, so you also decide how each source behaves in each distribution.
  • Own the connectors as a product. That covers the contract between connectors and the platform, versioning, and how quickly a new provider goes from evaluation to production. Every connector should make the next one cheaper. Where another team can reach a public source on its own, you give it a safe way to do so instead of putting it in our queue.
  • Own the admin interfaces. That means creating a connection, managing credentials, scheduling, health and status, logs, quota usage and permissions. A source we can’t monitor isn’t delivered, so every live connection needs a health check and clear failure states.
  • Work with partnerships and legal. You collaborate with the Director of OSINT and the Data Acquisition Manager to evaluate vendors, raise licensing and terms-of-service questions before we build, and turn the legal framework (storage, retention, redistribution) into product requirements. You also give the people negotiating contracts technical findings and cost per call.
  • Manage the teams around you. Upstream, you work with the teams building user-facing features, such as graphs and maps, who bring integration requests from their intelligence domain. You help them find the analyst question behind each request and decide whether a shared connector can serve several of them. Downstream, you work with the foundation teams for ontology, machine learning and processing, so incoming data arrives in a shape they can use. You forecast the load of every high-volume source before it goes live.
  • Shape person-focused investigation tools. You own how analysts go from a first lead about a person to a reviewed set of linked online identities. That includes how results are presented and reviewed, and how to avoid paying for the same lookup twice.
  • Measure the integration layer. Track sync success rate, data freshness, time to onboard a provider, active connections, and time to resolve a failed connection.

About you

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, with experience owning a technically complex area end-to-end, such as an integration platform, an API product, or data pipelines.
  • You are comfortable in API documentation. You can discuss OAuth versus API keys, polling versus webhooks, pagination and rate limits with engineers as an equal, and you can try an endpoint yourself in Postman or curl.
  • You have designed admin or configuration interfaces for technical users: connection setup, status and error states, audit trails.
  • You write specs and acceptance criteria that are specific enough to build

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here .

We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.
 
 Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.
 
 AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.
 
 About the role 
 
 In Faculty’s Applied AI group, we partner with ambitious organisations across private and public sectors to help them reinvent how they work, compete and serve people with AI.  Building and shipping impactful products that realise the potential of frontier AI.

 Leading discovery to identify the right problems to solve, using clear hypotheses and success measures to decide what gets built.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
V7 
 At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini). 

 
 The product 
 V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve . Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.
 Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.
 Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows .

 Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

 Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation .

 Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance .
 
 The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have 
 You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with engineers, designers and with the founders close by.

 Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

 The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

 It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

 
 What you’ll be doing from day one 
 Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

 Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

 Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

 Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoever asks.

 Writing things down clearly. Decisions, trade-offs, why we said no to something. It’s how a small team stays pointed the same way.

 Keeping the whole thing coherent. Workflows, Context Graph and chat need to feel like one product rather than three that happen to share a login. Most of the features are self-serve, so if it needs explaining, that's a product problem.

 
 Who you are 
 You’ve owned a product properly, at a startup or somewhere with a serious product culture. Not running a backlog someone else set.

 You've owned a real product area end to end at a startup or a company with a serious product culture. Discovery through launch, not backlog management.

 You've built for expert users who know their domain better than you do. B2B SaaS, fintech, insurtech, developer tools, data platforms.

 You're genuinely hands-on with LLMs and agents. You build with them, you have views on what they're good and bad at, and you can tell a demo from a product.

 You can hold a conversation with engineers about trade-offs without needing everything translated.

 You’re happy without much certainty. Priorities move here more than they would somewhere bigger.

 Opinionated but not precious about it.
 

 V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

  • Establish business cases and projected return on investment to identify and prioritize opportunities

  • Partner with Finance and Business Leaders to manage the impact on the profitability of the overall business.

  • Establish success metrics and executive reviews covering fraud trends and P&L impact.

We’re excited about you because you have…

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: PRODUCT MANAGER

We’re building a new customer platform, including AI Studio and our machine learning products, largely from scratch. These products need one person who owns what gets built, in what order, and why, and who makes sure what ships solves real problems for teams running AI and ML workloads on our GPU infrastructure. You’ll report to our Chief Product & Technology Officer and lead a team of three Product Engineers, based in London or Australia.

Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience.  At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
 This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
 At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
 
 Role Overview 
 As Harvey scales its post-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager - Product Specialist to lead and grow the Product Specialist team in Munich. This role was created to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Product Specialists who support existing customers in maximising their use of the Harvey platform.
 Harvey’s Legal Engineer - Product Specialists are experienced lawyers from top-tier firms who leverage their legal expertise to help customers seamlessly integrate Harvey into their daily workflows - driving adoption, increasing utilisation, and supporting long-term expansion and renewal. Legal Engineer - Product Specialists collaborate closely with Harvey’s Customer Success Managers to drive all facets of the post-sales strategy. They develop consultative relationships with law firm partners, associates, innovation teams, and in-house counsel, serving as trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can enhance legal effectiveness and efficiency.
 Legal Engineer - Product Specialists draw on their legal training and practice experience to ask thoughtful questions, uncover adoption barriers, and develop tailored strategies that build credibility with customers. They partner with Customer Success Managers to communicate Harvey’s value through a mix of large group sessions, small workshops, and one-on-one conversations.
 
 
 What You'll Do

 Own the post-implementation customer relationship from a legal engineering perspective, ensuring law firm and in-house clients are effectively onboarded, trained, and supported on an ongoing basis

What You Have

jobs.title: Product Development Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About TACTILIA: 
 At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.
 This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.
 You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?
 The Role 
 As a Product Development Lead at TACTILIA, you will be the operational backbone of our product development. You will turn customer requirements into a robust roadmap — and the roadmap into a product that reaches the customer on time, on budget and at production quality.
 You will lead through structure, clarity and commitment rather than hierarchy, and report to the CTO. You will work across product development, engineering and customer needs, keeping priorities aligned as TACTILIA moves from development towards production and scale.
 What you will do: 
 Own the product roadmap. Turn customer and market needs into clear product priorities and continuously balance customer value, engineering effort, technical risk, and time-to-market.

 Turn requirements into product decisions. Work with Applications and customers to translate needs into clear, testable specifications, maintaining traceability from RFQ through validation.

 Orchestrate product development. Coordinate Mechatronics, Software, Electronics, Systems Engineering and Applications across milestones, dependencies and interfaces, resolving conflicting priorities when needed.

 Drive the product to production. Own development milestones, gate reviews, budget, unit cost and quality through to production readiness, while helping establish a scalable product development process.

 Make the hard trade-offs. Bring together customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and schedule to make pragmatic decisions and keep development moving.

 Stay close to customers. Support the CTO in technical customer discussions, feasibility assessments, RFQs, trade fairs and partner conversations, bringing market feedback back into the product.

 Build the organisation around the product. Identify gaps in capacity, skills and ownership across engineering, translate them into concrete hiring needs, and make pragmatic make-or-buy decisions.

 Build for the real world. Work with engineering and operations to ensure the product is not only technically capable, but manufacturable, testable, reliable and ready to scale.

 What you bring: 
 A degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a comparable technical field.

 5+ years of experience developing mechatronic or hardware products, including experience in product development or technical project/program management.

 A proven track record taking products from requirements through development to production readiness.

 Strong requirements management and a solid understanding of systems engineering.

 Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary teams without direct line authority.

 Strong product judgment and the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and time-to-market.

 A hands-on, structured approach and the ability to move between strategic decisions and day-to-day execution.

 Fluent English; German is a strong plus.

 Bonus 
 Experience in robotics, drive technology, gripping technology, or other highly integrated mechatronic systems.

 Experience in a startup or scale-up environment, or a corporate spin-off.

 Familiarity with relevant robotics, machinery or functional safety standards.

 The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.
 At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.
 The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.
 That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.
 Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. 
 If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 Running the Engine Behind 200M+ Daily Ad Decisions

We operate a dedicated A/B testing environment against live traffic to validate system behavior under real-world conditions, allowing us to evaluate advertiser integrations, benchmark partner performance, and verify attribution accuracy end-to-end before deploying globally.

We integrate TensorFlow-based ML models to predict user engagement and purchase likelihood, directly influencing real-time ad distribution. To meet our strict 100ms latency constraint, we prioritize efficient model serving, low-latency data access, and deliberate system design.

 
 Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

You understand APIs and database architectures (like Druid) well enough to evaluate technical trade-offs, debate implementation details directly with engineers, and translate complex mechanics for commercial stakeholders.

We need a product leader who systematically defines success metrics, runs and evaluates A/B tests, and uses quantitative performance data to either iterate on winning logic or cut underperforming initiatives early.

We are looking for an experienced people manager who mentors team members in product thinking, delivery accountability, and commercial ownership.

 Hands-On AI Prototyping: You will accelerate product discovery and requirements definition by building functional proof-of-concepts yourself rather than waiting on dev cycles. You must be fluent enough with modern AI tooling to independently build and demonstrate a working prototype of a feature.

 Pluses (Technical & AdTech Background): Direct experience in the AdTech ecosystem or a formal technical background gives you a head start in understanding our external partner integrations, auction dynamics, and high-throughput data pipelines.
 

 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. 
 
What’s in It for You? 
At adjoe, we are not just managing campaigns, we're helping build the business engine behind one of the fastest-growing adtech platforms in mobile. We are proactively curious: we question status quo, think outside the box, connect the dots. The partnerships you close, the strategies you execute, and the markets you develop will directly shape how adjoe scales globally.
 Go Big. Own commercial initiatives that move revenue and expand adjoe's market position.

jobs.title: Head of Product – SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.
We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

 The role 
We are looking for our first Head of Product. You own what Qorelo builds and why, and you build the product function around it. You lead our solution architects, the people who carry our SAP domain depth, you work hand in hand with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you report directly to the C-level.
This is a leadership role at an early-stage company, which means two things at once. You set product strategy and make the big roadmap calls together with the founders, and you still write the spec, sit in the customer workshop and draw the cut line when it matters. Your decisions show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

 What you'll own 
• Product strategy. Where Qorelo goes across the transformation lifecycle, which problems we solve first and which we deliberately leave to others. You turn that into a roadmap the whole company understands.
• The roadmap and the calls behind it. You prioritise with evidence from customers, Proofs of Value and the market, and you can defend every call to the founders, to sales and to engineering.
• The product team. You lead our two solution architects today and grow the product team as we scale: hiring, coaching and setting the bar.
• Discovery with real users. Consultants, SAP leads and transformation teams use Qorelo inside live programmes. You and your team sit with them, see where the product wins and where it falls short, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.
• Product in the sales cycle. You join key customer and partner conversations, shape Proofs of Value with sales, and make sure what we promise matches what we ship.
• The bridge between SAP and AI. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost, and together with our solution architects you make sure what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.
• Shipping and outcomes. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines and success metrics. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Models and Data
jobs.description:
About Niantic Spatial
 AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run.
 That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.
 In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.
 Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.
 
 About the Role
 The Large Geospatial Model is Niantic Spatial's foundation model of the physical world. It learns from years of real-world captures of millions of places, and people, robots and AI agents use it to find out where they are, what is around them and what has changed. Each step up in scale has given the model capabilities it did not have before. The next problems are some of the hardest in AI: filling in the parts of a place no camera saw while marking what was inferred, measuring what changed between visits, and predicting what will change next.
 Customers already use the model in production. Energy companies use it to guide field crews to equipment on large industrial sites, defense partners use it for positioning where GPS is jammed or unavailable, and robotics companies train robots in metric-scale copies of the real sites they will work in.
 You will be the first product leader for the model and the data it learns from, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. You decide which capabilities it gains and in what order, the bar each release has to clear, and what data Niantic Spatial collects, licenses or partners for to get there. You set those priorities directly with the Chief Scientist and the London research team who train the model.
 If you have shipped a frontier language model, most of the job will be familiar: evals, data mix and release decisions. The job differs in two ways. Every output of this model can be scored against a measured real place, so its evals rest on ground truth. And its data is collected in the physical world, so choosing what to capture next is a product decision with a real cost. Experience in 3D or mapping is welcome but not required.
 By the end of your first year, research, engineering and the product leads for industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers work from one model roadmap that you own, each release ships against evals you wrote, and the model's newest capabilities are in customers' hands.
 
 What You'll Do
 Own the Model Roadmap - Decide the order in which the Large Geospatial Model gains its next capabilities, from filling in unseen parts of a site to measuring and predicting change, based on what industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers will pay for. Turn customer problems into specific research requirements, and bring new research results to the product leads who sell into each market.

 Set the Release Bar - Define the evals and acceptance criteria for each capability with the Real-World Test Lab, which measures model output against ground truth in real places. Decide whether each release ships or goes back for more data or training.

 Own the Data Plan - Decide what data Niantic Spatial collects, buys, licenses or gets through partners, and set the product terms of those deals with Legal and Business Development. Set the curation, labeling, consent, privacy and training-rights requirements every dataset has to meet, and keep a record of which data went into each model version.

 Turn Capabilities into Products - Decide when a new model capability is ready to become something customers buy, what it promises them, and how it reaches them through Niantic Spatial's products and platform.

 Set the Long-Term Direction - Decide where the model goes over the next several years, as it moves from describing places as they are to tracking how they change and anticipating what comes next, and make the case for the research and data investment that takes.

 
 What You'll Bring
 8+ years in product management, including at least three years shipping a large model to users or customers.

 Experience writing evals for a model and using them to decide when a release was ready.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Global Product Ops Excellence (All Genders)
jobs.description:
The role

From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the operating model: Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production). 
  • Design and scale standards: Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.
  • Lead cross-market change: Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.
  • Lead programs and automation: Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams. 
  • Lead under uncertainty: Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus
  • Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.
  • Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.
  • A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.
  • Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment. 
  • Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus. 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • 2 years contract.
  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.title: Head of Product Management & Transformation (Risk, Finance & Compliance)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and visionary professional to join as Head of Product Management (Risk, Finance & Compliance) , taking strategic responsibility for a newly established Product Management division within a leading Swiss banking environment.
 In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for the strategic direction, development and management of the product portfolio across Risk, Finance and Compliance . You will act as a central interface between business functions, IT and Senior Management, ensuring that business requirements are translated into effective, sustainable and customer-oriented solutions.
 The position combines strategic product management, leadership, digital transformation and stakeholder management , with a clear focus on measurable business value and the continuous development of end-to-end processes across the organisation.
 
Workload: 80–100%

 Your Responsibilities 
 Take end-to-end responsibility for the Product Management division covering Risk, Finance & Compliance

 Define and implement the strategic vision, product portfolio and roadmap for the relevant business areas

 Develop customer-oriented solutions aligned with the needs of Business Owners and specialist departments

 Manage the implementation and continuous development of products within the Agile Release Train

 Lead and develop the Product Management team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus

 Act as the central interface between Risk, Finance, Compliance, IT, Business Owners and other relevant stakeholders

 Ensure that business requirements are translated into effective and sustainable IT solutions

 Further develop and digitalise end-to-end business processes across applications, processes and channels

 Ensure a measurable contribution of the product division to the organisation's strategic objectives, particularly in the areas of growth, efficiency and customer satisfaction

 Lead and support transformation initiatives across Risk, Finance and Compliance

 Manage complex stakeholder environments and align strategic priorities with implementation and IT delivery

 Ensure that processes and solutions comply with regulatory and compliance requirements

 Work closely with Senior Management and relevant internal and external stakeholders

 Monitor performance, priorities and value contribution across the product portfolio

 Identify opportunities for innovation, process optimisation and further development of the product landscape

 
 Your Profile 
 Several years of professional experience in a leadership position within the financial services or banking industry

 Strong understanding of Risk, Finance and Compliance processes within a banking environment

 Proven experience in product management, product strategy and/or business transformation

 Excellent understanding of end-to-end processes and value creation within the financial services sector

 Experience leading and developing teams and managing complex organisational structures

 Proven track record in transformation projects, as well as experience with agile methodologies and modern organisational structures

 Strong understanding of IT and technological interdependencies, with the ability to bridge the gap between business and IT

 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly when working with Senior Management

 Entrepreneurial mindset combined with a pragmatic, decisive and results-oriented approach

 Ability to set clear priorities and successfully drive strategic initiatives through to implementation

 Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a hands-on execution mindset

 University degree in Business Administration, Banking, Business Information Systems or a comparable field

 Very good written and spoken German and English

 
 What We Offer 
 A strategic leadership position with comprehensive responsibility for an entire Product Management division

 The opportunity to actively shape a newly established Product Management organisation covering Risk, Finance & Compliance

 Significant influence on the bank's digital transformation and future product landscape

 A high degree of autonomy and entrepreneurial responsibility

Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Every product we sell, from photo books to calendars to canvases, is defined in our product model and catalogue. It sits under almost everything we do, and we are reshaping it as we move our ecommerce platform towards proven, bought capabilities. You will lead that work. Your customers are internal: the engineers, systems and teams who launch and sell our products every day. This is a platform role with real scope and real complexity, and we will be upfront about both.

 How you embrace curiosity daily 
 

 
 You own the roadmap for our product model, catalogue and platform capabilities, from first idea to measured impact.

 
 You untangle a grown, multi-brand landscape and turn it into something simple and self-service.

 
 You help shape what we buy, what we build and what we retire, with clear numbers behind each call.

 
 You work closely with engineers on trade-offs, and with product operations, marketing and production as true customers.

 
 You push back constructively when a one-off request should be a reusable capability.

 
 You use AI tools in your own workflow and across the product cycle, and you are curious about where they help and where they do not.

 How you make your mark 
 

 
 Teams launch new products faster, with fewer tickets and less manual work.

 
 You build a roadmap that balances platform health, delivery and commercial value.

 
 You bring people along the journey early, so nobody works in isolation.

 
 You turn deep system decisions into outcomes the business can see.

 What you bring to the team 
 

 
 5+ years as a Product Manager, ideally on platform or shared-service products.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
jobs.description:
Introduction 
 Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage. As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap.

 What you'll do 
 

 Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality.

 Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog.

 Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively.

 Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage.

 Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes.

 Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves.

 Data acumen — able to analyze data from multiple sources, such as GPS traces, probes, STOs, camera observations, and traffic authorities, to drive decisions and assess tradeoffs.

 Build strong cross-functional relationships and steer the product team by removing blockers and escalating appropriately.

 Communicate effectively to internal teams (automotive, navigation, delivery) and external stakeholders using customer problem statements and business logic; deliver concise presentations and lead meetings from standups to stakeholder reviews.

 Maintain product strategy and vision, and contribute to broader Traffic discussions; formulate compelling value propositions tied to articulated problems and product metrics.

 Establish yourself as the subject-matter expert and go-to person for live and historical traffic data products, maintaining trust across product and business teams with visible, citable personal impact.

 What you'll need 
 

 A minimum of 5 years' experience as a Product Manager, preferably in traffic, geospatial, mobility, or automotive domains.

 A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.

 Familiarity with real-time data processing, GPS/probe data, or traffic and mobility analytics (preferred).

 Experience or technical training in data science, analytics, or related disciplines.

 Strong ability to understand, articulate, and represent customer needs and requirements.

 Proven ability to coordinate people and technical resources across multiple teams.

 Effective time management and strong interpersonal communication skills.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with senior technical and executive audiences.

 Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 Strong problem-solving skills and creative, structured thinking.

 What we offer 
 

 A competitive compensation package, of course. 
 

 Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 
 

 Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. 
 

 Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.
 

 Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 
 

 Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. 
 

 Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 
 

 Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product (Head of International - Real Time Operations)
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

The Role

As Head of International – Real Time Operations, you will own the strategy and execution for expanding the Fusus platform into international markets. This role is central to ensuring that Fusus can compete, win, and deliver at scale outside the U.S., while remaining aligned with Axon’s broader global product strategy.

You will define the expansion and maturity model that ensures Fusus succeeds internationally, harmonizing requirements across regions while avoiding “parity for parity’s sake.” You will partner closely with sales leadership and new markets international leadership to understand tender pipelines and prioritize the right investments that enables Axon to win deals and delight customers, while balancing core deliverables and sustainability.

This position requires a leader who can both lead directly and influence without direct authority, working across product, engineering, sales, and program teams to set strategy, make tradeoffs, and align on execution.

Your Impact

  • Define the international product strategy for Fusus, balancing competitiveness, sustainability, and scalability.
  • Partner directly with international sales leadership to evaluate pipeline opportunities, shape tender responses, and prioritize engineering work to win deals.
  • Harmonize requirements across countries and regions, ensuring strategic parity with U.S. markets where necessary, while building features and capabilities that truly matter for international success.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and program leaders to ensure international deliverables are embedded in Axon’s global roadmap.
  • Ensure compliance with regional security, privacy, and data residency standards critical to customer trust and adoption.
  • Drive continuous improvement in tender readiness, adoption, and customer success metrics across regions.
  • Act as a champion for international customer and partner needs within RTO, ensuring they inform product priorities at all stages.

What You’ll Do

Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: SVP & General Manager

  • Build strong partnerships across Axon (devices, digital evidence, productivity solutions) to deliver integrated outcomes internationally.
  • Lead direct engagement with international customers, regulators, and partners to distill insights into product priorities.
  • Establish a clear execution path within 90 days that defines roadmap priorities and sequencing for international expansion.
  • Align with the Head of International (Core Products & New Markets) to ensure RTO’s global efforts are consistent with company-wide strategy.
  • Create frameworks and processes that balance local customization with global scale.
  • Serve as a visible leader and trusted advisor for RTO’s international strategy, both internally and externally.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, real-time operations, VSaaS, VMS, IoT, or public safety technology.
  • Proven success in international product leadership, including experience scaling platforms across multiple regions with diverse compliance and operational requirements.
  • Experience partnering with sales leadership on tender-driven opportunities, translating deal pipelines into prioritized product roadmaps.
  • Strong understanding of global compliance standards (privacy, data residency, security) and their impact on product delivery.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. 

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 About the role
 Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.

 Own positioning and messaging execution . Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

 Build and maintain competitive intelligence . Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

 Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

 Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

 Drive product launches and releases . Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

 Fuel demand and thought leadership . Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

 Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

 Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

 Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

 A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

 Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

 Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

 Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager

About Artificial 
 Help shape the future of specialty insurance 

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.
 We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.
 You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.
 We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.
 Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.
 About the role 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own outcomes end to end: framing the problem, shaping the smallest version that moves it, shipping it in collaboration with other teams, and proving whether it landed with our clients.
 We are currently scaling our Product offering so you’ll be joining an established team made up of product, insurance and technical experts to meet the demands of our growing client pipeline.
 This opportunity would be ideal for a Senior Product Manager who has worked in a scale-up previously, and wants to take on genuinely challenging problems in specialty insurance. It is a client-facing role: you will spend real time with clients in the specialty insurance and reinsurance market, and you will need to hold a position when a client's request and the right product decision diverge. This is a true 'hands-on' role, going beyond traditional backlog management or delivery coordination. You will also help us sharpen how the product team operates as we grow.
 Responsibilities 
 Work across discovery, delivery and optimisation: turn problems and opportunities into well-shaped work with a clear hypothesis, ship it, and improve what is already live. Set the standard for how this is done, so other product managers can learn from the work you produce.

 Decide what to build next and what to stop. Design the research and measurement that will answer the question in front of you, and show the reasoning behind each decision.

 Lead roadmap and delivery conversations with clients as a peer. Where a client's request and the right product decision diverge, hold the position and explain why.

 Hold scope to the smallest version that still moves the outcome, working with cross-functional teams to ship iterative enhancements, and coach that same discipline across the teams you work with.

 Own the roadmap for your client engagement and set its direction within company strategy. Agree priorities and timing with the VP of Product, and decide what to stop and why.

 Own a product initiative across your client engagement from start to finish, including its milestones and how you will know it has succeeded.

 Feed what you learn from your clients into our view of the target state for digital and connected insurance businesses.

 First Three Months 
 In the early days of your role, you’ll be expected to focus on:
 Building relationships across teams to support project success

 Leading discussions with both internal and external stakeholders

 Making sure everyone at Artificial is aligned on what is important

 Delivering against our continuous roadmap, and starting to form a view on how we'll know they've landed well with customers

 Forming direct relationships with external stakeholders

 Gaining meaningful insight into our current processes and ways of working that could benefit from fresh eyes

 Taking ownership of the work flowing through your area, and building the relationships and context needed to make the calls yourself.

jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Unity Advisory. 
 Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.
 
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly organised and delivery-oriented Operations Project Manager to join our growing internal operations team. You will work closely with senior leadership - including the COO - to support and drive cross-functional initiatives that scale our operations and improve internal efficiency.
 This is a hybrid role based out of our Mayfair office. It is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and is eager to take ownership of operational delivery while learning the mechanics of a rapidly growing advisory firm.
 In due course, the successful candidate will also have the opportunity to take on client-facing project responsibilities - supporting or leading engagements across our advisory offerings, including operating model design, AI-enabled transformation, finance optimisation and managed services.

 Responsibilities 
 
 What You’ll Do
 Manage and deliver internal strategic and operational projects from planning to execution (e.g. systems rollout, process improvement, knowledge management, resource planning).

 Work closely with the COO and other leaders to track key firm-wide initiatives, identify dependencies, and proactively manage risks and blockers.

 Build and maintain project plans, RAID logs, status updates and communication materials for internal stakeholders.

 Partner with business functions (e.g. Finance, People, Tech, Client Delivery) to ensure seamless coordination of operational workflows.

 Support continuous improvement across core business systems, knowledge tools, and operational governance - driving efficiencies and automation using technology and AI tools where feasible.

 Coordinate and document internal operating rhythms - standups, steering groups, retrospectives, etc.

 Support leadership with strategic planning cycles and key internal deliverables.

 In time, support or lead delivery of external client-facing engagements in line with Unity Advisory’s service offerings.

 Contribute to shaping a high-performing operations function that scales with the firm.

 
 What You Bring
 Demonstrable experience in operations, business management, or project delivery - ideally in a professional services or consulting environment.

 Strong project management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive outcomes at pace.

 High attention to detail and an ownership mindset; comfortable working independently and escalating where needed.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information clearly.

 Collaborative, low-ego approach to working across teams and levels.

 Comfortable using modern productivity tools (e.g. Notion, Asana, Miro, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides).

 Familiarity with agile methodologies, OKRs or similar performance frameworks is a plus.

 Interest in working in a fast-scaling, AI-enabled professional services environment, with curiosity to understand the end-to-end operation of a modern, high-growth business.

 Nice to Have
 Experience in client-facing roles or a willingness to develop into one.

 Exposure to internal consulting, senior stakeholders (e.g. COO and senior management), or business transformation projects.

 Experience working in or with high-growth organisations or start-up/scale-up environments.

 Experience working with private equity.

 
 Working at Unity Advisory
 We offer a flexible and hybrid working environment, where individuals are empowered to drive impact. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the operational backbone of a modern advisory firm and gain exposure to both internal strategic delivery and external client engagements. You’ll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that’s redefining what advisory can look like in the age of AI.
 
 Additional Information
 We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Launch Manager - Beauty & Skin Care (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei Rosental Organics übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für neue Skincare-Produkte und Beauty Tools, vom Business Case über den Go-to-Market bis zur Performance nach dem Launch. Du verbindest Produkt, Customer Insight und Growth und arbeitest dafür eng mit Head of Product, Product Development, Marketing, E-Commerce und CEO zusammen. Dein Ziel sind nicht möglichst viele Launches, sondern Produkte, die Rosentals nächste Hero Products werden können. Du entwickelst für neue Produkte den kommerziellen Business Case, von Consumer Need und Marktpotenzial über Pricing, Target COGS und Marge bis zum Absatzpotenzial.

 
 Customer Insights, Reviews sowie Markt- und Social-Trends übersetzt du in klare Hero-Product-Konzepte. 

 Den gesamten Go-to-Market-Prozess ownst du. Produkt, Packaging, Claims, Creative, Content, E-Commerce und Marketing greifen zum Launch nahtlos ineinander. 

 Cross-funktionale Launch-Pläne, Critical Paths und Milestones steuerst du so, dass mindestens 90 % aller Milestones fristgerecht erreicht werden. 

 Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Creative entstehen unter deiner Führung Product Stories, Hooks, Claims und Proof Points, die überzeugen und Performance treiben. 

 Mit dem Launch bist du nicht fertig: Die ersten 30/60/90 Tage analysierst du anhand von Umsatz, Conversion, Reviews, Repeat, Marge und Customer Feedback und leitest konkrete Wachstumsmaßnahmen ab. 

 Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Product Management, Go-to-Market, Launch Management oder Growth im Beauty-, Skincare-, Consumer- oder D2C-Umfeld. 

 Mehrere physische Produkte hast du von der Idee bis zum Marktlaunch begleitet und kannst erklären, warum sie kommerziell funktioniert haben. 

 Consumer- und Product-Taste verbindest du mit solidem Verständnis für Pricing, Marge, Business Cases und Wachstum. 

 Komplexe cross-funktionale Projekte zu führen, Prioritäten zu setzen und Teams auf ein gemeinsames Ziel auszurichten, ist deine Stärke. 

 Du arbeitest hands-on, schnell und mit hoher Ownership und wartest nicht auf den nächsten Schritt von anderen. 

 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1) und sehr gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Global Product Ops Excellence (All Genders)
jobs.description:
The role

From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the operating model: Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production). 
  • Design and scale standards: Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.
  • Lead cross-market change: Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.
  • Lead programs and automation: Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams. 
  • Lead under uncertainty: Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus
  • Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.
  • Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.
  • A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.
  • Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment. 
  • Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus. 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • 2 years contract.
  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions.

jobs.title: Endear - Product Manager

Our Story 
 At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline.
 
 Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.
 
 We work with brands like Gorjana, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

 This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who can operate autonomously, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration. You'll have meaningful ownership over what gets built, why it matters, and how we measure success, while partnering with product leadership on broader vision and direction.
 
 AI fluency is central to how we work. You'll use AI to accelerate discovery, bring ideas to life through prototyping, automate workflows, and help the team deliver value faster.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Job Title: Director of Product Management 

Location: Remote 

Company: PlayStation Studios 

As the Director of Product Management, you will work as part of the central Live Services team, reporting to the Head of Product Management for Live Service games at PlayStation Studios. Your primary responsibility is to work as a subject matter expert, leading a small central team collaborating with European game studios and other partners (analytics, marketing, etc.) to help build, launch, and manage successful live service games, while helping studios to build out top-notch embedded capabilities. 

Responsibilities

  • Work across multiple live and upcoming titles from PlayStation Studios, partnering closely with game studios and other partners to build capabilities and successfully launch and manage live service titles. 
  • Engage with game teams on everything from high-level product and commercial strategy to evaluating design specs and mockups, with a focus on product prioritization and roadmaps. 
  • Identify opportunities for product performance growth for various titles, influence key stakeholders, and drive initiatives to a successful outcome through strong relationships. 
  • Develop and share best practices to help game studios stand up and evolve their processes and capabilities. 
  • Define product strategy frameworks and standards for live service titles, tailoring approaches to the needs of individual games and studios. 
  • Define and evolve core KPIs in partnership with other publishing resources (analytics, research, marketing, etc), ensuring consistent measurement and actionable insights across titles. 
  • Establish and evolve live service operating rhythms (goal setting, performance reviews, experimentation, roadmap planning, decision trees) across titles. 
  • Partner with finance and forecasting teams to refine revenue models, ensuring assumptions align with product strategy and core KPIs. 
  • Manage, develop, and grow a small team of product management and live service design talent, leading and inspiring a highly skilled team. 
  • Connect development teams across PlayStation studios to the latest competitive research, analyze industry trends, and define best practices. 
  • Function as a conduit between multiple studios to foster knowledge sharing and deeper collaboration. 
  • Help define the processes and methodologies used centrally to level up our product management craft and improve the way we build and operate live service games. 

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong experience in product management and/or live service design focused on feature development and live operations. 
  • Proven track record working in complex, matrixed development/publishing organizations to deliver outsized results on successful live games. 
  • Seasoned people leader with an ability to manage, lead and inspire a highly skilled team. 
  • Demonstrated track record of success driving initiatives that positively impact core KPIs. 
  • Expert data fluency and track record of partnering with analytics, research, and insights groups. 
  • Experience with game economy and/or monetization modeling and experience with analytical tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, etc.). 
  • Diverse development experience spanning different types of games, genres, and business models (F2P, paid, cosmetic economy, etc.). 
  • Expert ability to connect creative vision, analytics, and business goals – turning data into actionable product and design decisions.
