jobs.title: Enterprise AI Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Legal 500 
 
 Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.
 
 Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.
 
 We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.
 
 About the Role 
 
 Our new Enterprise AI Product Owner will own the adoption and value of AI in how Legal 500 works. You'll use our enterprise AI tools, with Microsoft Copilot and the wider Microsoft 365 AI capability as the main platform. You'll recommend what should be built or adopted and why, put governance in place where none yet exists, and make sure people across the business use the tools well.
 This is a business-facing product role that starts from how the business works, not a technical build role. Copilot is the primary tool of choice, but you'll also oversee the other AI tools the business adopts.
 
 
 What you'll do 
 You'll sit centrally within our People & Business Operations function, reporting to the Director of People & Business Operations. Your remit covers the whole of Legal 500, not a single department. You'll:
 Own the roadmap and prioritised backlog for our enterprise AI opportunities, recommending what to build or adopt, what not to, and why. You'll write clear user stories and acceptance criteria and hold a consistent line with senior stakeholders when demand exceeds capacity.

 Start every opportunity from the end-to-end business process. You'll walk business owners through how work gets done today, often where no SOPs exist, map the pain points, coach them through mapping a future-state process, and find where Copilot, other AI tools or workflow changes will make a measurable difference.

 Personally configure, test and refine Copilot skills, agents and team workflows. You'll take ideas through proof of concept and pilot, then hand ownership of the output to the business owner.

 Design, implement and enforce AI governance from the ground up. This includes owning the intake and review process for new use cases, agents and workflows, working alongside our Data Protection Officer, Information Security and IT Operations

 Own our enterprise AI libraries: the register of approved tools and the libraries of approved agents, prompts, templates and shared workflows. You'll keep them curated, current and compliant, and avoid duplication between tools.

 Design and deliver upskilling yourself, including training sessions, guides, clinics and self-serve resources. You'll also lead AI working groups and champion networks.

 Spot common patterns across teams and bring them together on shared processes and solutions, so the same problem isn't solved many times.

 Define and track adoption and value, such as usage, time saved, quality and user confidence. You'll maintain an AI benefits register, report progress to senior stakeholders and feed role impact into workforce planning.

 
 
 What we're looking for 
 Essential 
 A process-led consulting approach, with a structured way of walking business owners through end-to-end processes, including where no SOPs existed

 Proven experience of setting up AI governance from scratch and enforcing it. This includes owning an intake and review process and working with specialists such as a Data Protection Officer and IT Operations

 Hands-on Microsoft Copilot experience: you've personally configured Copilot skills, agents or team workflows. Using Copilot, or overseeing someone else configuring it, isn't enough

 Strong product management skills: setting priorities, writing user stories, running a backlog and managing senior stakeholders well

 Experience of owning enterprise libraries or other centralised controls

 Experience of running enablement yourself: you've designed and delivered upskilling personally, without relying on an L&D team, and you're comfortable leading working groups

 
 Desirable 
 A genuine interest in enterprise efficiency and how people actually work, with a track record of bringing teams together on shared ways of working

 A background in internal transformation, process improvement or Microsoft 365/Copilot SME roles, ideally including evaluating, onboarding or governing other enterprise AI tools

 An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets or other knowledge

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Gateway
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 
 AI is now part of almost every workflow built on n8n. But before a new user can build their first AI automation, they often hit a wall: sign up with a model provider, create an API key, add billing, and paste credentials into n8n. Many people never get past that step.
 
 The Relay team removes that wall. With Gateway credits, n8n Cloud users get leading AI models and services such as web search, scraping and document parsing built in, with no keys to manage. A new user can open a template or ask the AI assistant to build something, and it just works on day one.

 
 Make day-one success the default
 Own the Gateway credits experience end to end: from sign-up to first successful AI workflow or Agent, to ongoing usage.

 Remove credential friction across the product. Work with the Growth, Agents and n8n Assistant teams so new users land on services that work out of the box.

 Decide which models and services we offer, and how we price and package them for users..

 
 Build and run provider partnerships
 Own relationships with model and tool providers, from first conversation to signed deal.

 Lead commercial negotiations, including volume commitments, pricing and terms.

 Partner with Finance on commitment approvals and consumption forecasting.

 Decide when to add, expand or drop a provider, based on user demand, quality and cost.

 
 Shape the enterprise AI gateway
 Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects: platform teams, IT and security leads, and AI owners.

 Turn what you learn into a clear product strategy, and be honest about what to build, what to pause and what to stop.

 Define the core capabilities: virtual keys, budgets and spend limits, model access policies, usage reporting and audit.

 Consider how the gateway works for self-hosted and Cloud customers. Work closely with engineering and our Cloud team on deployment questions.

 Help define how the enterprise gateway is packaged and sold, together with Sales, Finance and leadership.

 
 Lead across teams
 Work with a dedicated engineering team, and with design, as one product team.

 Coordinate with teams that own nearby areas, such as identity and access management, governance, billing and the Cloud experience.

 Keep leadership, Sales and Customer Success informed, and bring them clear recommendations.

 
 REQUIREMENTS
 
 Must-haves 
 Experience as a PM for AI infrastructure, developer platforms or LLM tooling (for example AI gateways, model APIs, or AI platform products), or for enterprise admin and governance products (for example access control, policy, spend management or audit).

 Hands-on experience with partner or vendor deals: you have negotiated terms, not only managed relationships.

 A strong grasp of usage-based pricing, unit costs and consumption forecasting.

 Comfort talking with enterprise buyers: platform engineers, security teams and IT leaders.

 Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

 Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

 Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition 

 
 Nice-to-haves 
 You have built or run an LLM gateway or proxy, or worked closely with tools like LiteLLM, Portkey or similar.

 Experience with products that run both self-hosted and as SaaS.

 You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.

jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay 
 DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.
 Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.
 
 Warum es diese Rolle gibt 
 DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.
 Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.
 
 Deine Rolle 
 Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.
 
 Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.
 
 Was du konkret machst 
 Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

 OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

 Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

 Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

 User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

 Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

 Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

 Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

 
 Das brauchst du 
 Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

 Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

 Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

 Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

 Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

 Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

 Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

 
 Das fällt positiv auf 
 Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

 Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

 Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

 Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

 Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

 Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

 Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von U

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands. 

Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.

As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products
  • Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences
  • Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads
  • Establish and manage to SLAs within your team
  • Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team
  • Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development
  • 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams
  • You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them.
  • Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously.
  • Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Private Pension plan with Employer-matching
  • 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan
  • Income Replacement Programs
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team. You will own how DataSnipper’s products are understood and chosen in a crowded AI landscape. You will be the voice of competition, the buyer, and the message across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Product. You will join a small Product Marketing team where your work directly affects pipeline growth globally.
 
 About DataSnipper 
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.
 Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Competitive Intelligence
 Own competitive intelligence end-to-end: track competitors, draft the insight, and turn it into positioning.

 Build and maintain battlecards, objection handling, and playbooks for Sales and Marketing.

 Partner closely with Sales and Product leadership to ensure content is used, measurable, and effective.

 Set up a feedback loop between Sales, Marketing, and Product, and bring market input into roadmap discussions.

 Buyer Personas
 Create and maintain buyer personas for our key audiences.

 Ground them in customer research, win-loss, and sales input. Keep them current.

 Work with Sales to sharpen ICP and qualification criteria.

 Messaging
 Evolve product positioning, value propositions, and messaging that set us apart from competitors.

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value.

 Keep messaging consistent across web, content, campaigns, and sales.
 

 What Success Looks Like 
 Sales teams are fully equipped with enablement content they actually use.

 Product messaging is consistent and clearly different from competitors.

 Personas and messaging reflect what we hear in the market.

 DataSnipper’s value proposition becomes easier to understand, harder to compete with, and stronger across all channels.
 

 What You Bring 
 6–8 years of B2B SaaS Product Marketing, ideally within a scale-up.

 Proven competitive intelligence and positioning work that helped win deals.

 Experience building battlecards and sales content that teams use.

 Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear customer value stories and compelling narratives.

 Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a sharp eye for storytelling, structure, and clarity.

 Nice to have: audit, finance, or other regulated-industry buyers.
 

 What We Offer 
 Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

 Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

 Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

 Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

 Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

 NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

 Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

 Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

 Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

 Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing

  
 Recruitment Process 
 Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

 Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes, online)

 Assessment Interview (60 minutes, on-site)

 Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

  
 At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. 
 Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

jobs.title: Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H
jobs.description:
Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN.

 
 Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter.

 Ce que tu fais concrètement : 
 Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes.

 Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber.

 Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher.

 Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route.

 Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends.

 Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

 Tu as déjà vu ce que l’automatisation des flux ou un algorithme de prévision change sur un produit supply chain ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l’IA partout.

 
 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?
 
 Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

 Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

 Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.) 

 Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

 Le package : 42.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.
 

👉 Le profil que nous recherchons 
 Tu justifies d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux avec un passage par la supply chain, la logistique, le transport international ou les référentiels de données critiques.

 Tu es à l’aise dans des architectures fonctionnelles denses et des modèles de données interconnectés, avec une exigence forte sur la qualité de la donnée. Le pilotage de roadmap et de backlog fait partie de ton quotidien, et ton orientation valeur est ton moteur.

 Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une communication capable d’embarquer des interlocuteurs internationaux et dispersés, et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

 Anglais professionnel attendu.

 Environnement technique que tu croiseras : Jira, Confluence, Figma, data lakes, API REST, écosystèmes ERP et TMS.

 Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? 
 Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle
 Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager
 Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP
 Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche
 Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !
 Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.
 What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.
 In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.
 And we’re a long way from done!

 THE ROLE 
 Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be. 
 We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. 
 This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. 
 If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.
  
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 Product Strategy & Execution: 
 Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why 

 Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value 

 Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour 

 Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics 

 Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

 
 Design & Engineering Partnership: 
 Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts 

 Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse 

 Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

 
 Cross-functional Leadership: 
 Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently 

 Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal 

 Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics 

 Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox 

 AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers 

 Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in 

 A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality 

 Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided consumer products 

 Familiarity with habit loops and engagement design in a consumer app: push, onboarding, personalisation

Notre équipe Digital Procurement & Pricing recherche un·e Digital Product Manager - Price Management (ContextIQ) (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille (Upline).

Au sein de l'écosystème digital de Decathlon, notre équipe conçoit des solutions d'aide à la décision pour les équipes Procurement à l'échelle mondiale. En synergie avec le Purchase COE (Center of Excellence), nous développons des produits comme ContextIQ, PYC et Datacost afin d'éclairer la stratégie d'achat par la donnée. Nous recherchons un·e Product Manager passionné·e par la valeur métier, la simplicité d'usage et les produits data pour piloter l'évolution de ContextIQ.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que Digital Product Manager sur ContextIQ, ta mission est de transformer les besoins complexes des acheteurs et acheteuses en une expérience produit fluide et un backlog clair et priorisé :

  • Vision et stratégie produit : Définir la feuille de route (roadmap), la vision produit et les indicateurs clés de succès (KPIs, adoption, valeur business délivrée).

  • Product Discovery & Prototypage : Explorer les besoins des équipes achats, concevoir et tester des parcours utilisateurs et des prototypes interactifs.

  • Delivery & Priorisation : Rédiger des spécifications fonctionnelles claires, prioriser le backlog selon la valeur apportée et accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie dans les cycles de delivery.

  • Écosystème & Gouvernance Data : Collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour assurer l'intégration continue de ContextIQ avec les autres plateformes de pricing (PYC, Datacost), veiller à la gouvernance de la donnée et préparer l'intégration de solutions IA (AI-ready).

  • Accompagnement & Adoption : Mesurer l'impact des fonctionnalités déployées, animer les retours d'expérience et favoriser l'adoption auprès des communautés d'acheteurs.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience confirmée en Digital Product Management, de la phase de discovery jusqu'au delivery continu.

  • Capacité d'animation, d'écoute active et de facilitation avec des parties prenantes transverses (business, data, ingénierie).

  • Solide maîtrise des méthodes de priorisation par la valeur, de la formalisation des besoins et de la gestion de backlog.

  • Pratique des tests utilisateurs et du prototypage rapide (maîtrise d'outils type Figma appréciée).

  • Appétence ou expérience avérée dans le domaine des achats (Procurement), du price management ou de l'analyse de données.

  • Sensibilité aux enjeux d'intégration technique (API, flux de données) et à la gouvernance de la donnée.

  • Communication claire, esprit d'analyse et aisance dans un environnement collaboratif et évolutif.

STACK TECHNIQUE & ÉCOSYSTÈME

  • Outils Product & Discovery : Figma, Jira, Confluence, analytics & user testing tools.

  • Data & Architecture : Notions solides en API REST, intégration de données, data governance et pipelines d'alimentation pour modèles IA.

  • Écosystème métier : Outils

 ➡️ What you'll do 
 Own a section of qonto.com end-to-end: You'll be responsible for a defined part of the website — from identifying conversion problems to shipping the fixes. That means defining the strategy, running the sprints, and tracking the impact.

 Run a continuous experimentation cycle: Set up and analyse A/B tests using tools like AB Tasty or VWO, draw conclusions from GA4 and Contentsquare data, and iterate fast. You'll be expected to have tests running at all times.

 Align cross-functional stakeholders: You'll work weekly with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Legal, and the French market. Getting alignment without authority is part of the job.

 Promote Qonto's products on the website: Work with product teams to translate new features into compelling, conversion-optimised website experiences — landing pages, navigation flows, upsell surfaces.

 Benchmark and bring new ideas: Regularly analyse competitor websites and best-in-class B2B SaaS sites to identify opportunities Qonto hasn't tried yet.

 
 ➡️ What we're looking for 
 3-4 years of PM experience: You've shipped features end-to-end and can show the before/after on a metric. B2B SaaS or growth-focused product experience is a strong plus.

 Hands-on with web analytics and CRO tools: You've used GA4, Contentsquare, Hotjar, or equivalent. You can pull your own data, spot patterns, and build a hypothesis without waiting for an analyst.

 A/B testing methodology: You know how to size a test, define a success metric, and avoid common pitfalls (peeking, underpowered tests). You've run tests that failed and learned from them.

 Clear communicator across functions: You can write a crisp brief for a designer, explain a prioritisation call to a sceptical stakeholder, and present results to a non-technical audience.

 Working language: English and French fluency is required. Italian, Spanish, German or Dutch is a genuine plus given our 8-market scope.

 
 ➡️ What we can offer you 
 A website that is actually the product: At Qonto, qonto.com is not a marketing brochure — it's the #1 source of new customers. The PM who owns conversion has direct revenue impact, which means your work gets attention and resources.

 A real feature team: You'll work in a squad with dedicated Growth Engineers and Designers — daily standups, weekly sprints, shared OKRs. You're not a lone PM throwing specs over a wall.

 8 markets, real complexity: The website serves France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, and Austria — with different regulatory contexts, languages, and user behaviours. That's a genuine product challenge, not a copy-paste localisation exercise.

We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

The Product Manager owns strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) domain of the Zone & Co platform — covering procurement, vendor management, AP automation, invoice capture, approvals, and payments. Reporting to the Director of Product, this role spans the full product lifecycle, from discovery through launch and ongoing health of live features.

You'll translate complex AP/procurement workflows (requisition-to-approval, three-way match, invoice capture, payment execution) into intuitive software built natively on Oracle NetSuite.  Votre profil

 l'envie de questionner les demandes et de proposer des solutions utiles aux clients 
 de la rigueur : vous vérifiez avant d'affirmer 
 de la curiosité pour le fonctionnement d'un logiciel : droits, données, paramétrage 
 une expérience en recette ou en test 
 la pratique de Jira et Confluence 
 l'habitude d'utiliser des outils d'IA au quotidien 
 l'anglais écrit, nos produits et leur documentation existent aussi en anglais 
 Pourquoi nous rejoindre 
 Des produits concrets, utilisés chaque jour par nos clients, dans un domaine exigeant (réglementation, sécurité). 
 Un rôle où vous avez la main sur l'organisation du backlog et de la documentation produit. 
 Une autonomie croissante dans les décisions fonctionnelles et la priorisation, à mesure que vous maîtrisez les produits. 
 Une équipe à taille humaine, avec des échanges directs avec la direction, la R&D, le consulting et le support.

 Quatre étapes :

 Un dernier échange avec la direction.

 Contrat : CDI, statut cadre.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Location: London (Next to East Croydon Station)
 Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days from home
 Reports to: CTO
 
 About Us
 Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.
 With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

 Role Overview
 You will be the product owner for one of our product teams. You own that team’s backlog, the discovery work behind it, the acceptance of what the team builds, and the conversations with the customers it is built for. You report to the CTO, and our product manager, who owns product strategy and the roadmap across the teams, supervises your work day to day.
 This is a product role first and a coding role second. You also generate code with AI tools, mostly on the front end, at roughly the level of a junior to mid-level engineer. We expect you to build working prototypes and small features that an engineer then takes over. We do not expect back-end work, architecture or being on call.
 Our teams are formed from the people we have at the time, so you are not being hired into a named team. You will work with the engineers in your team, the product manager, the CTO and our customer-facing colleagues.
 In your first year, you will get a team running on your backlog without the CTO or the product manager stepping in, and you will have personally shipped front-end changes and prototypes that engineers took forward.

 Key Responsibilities
 Own your team’s backlog: decide what goes in, what stays out and what comes next, and keep it in order.

 Run discovery with customers, so that what the team builds is something customers need and will use.

 Turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices of work with precise acceptance criteria that an engineer can build and a customer can recognise.

 Accept the team’s work against the acceptance criteria.

 Say no, or reshape the request, when a customer asks for something that does not fit, and agree a next step with them.

 Build prototypes and small front-end features with AI tools, check what the tools produce, and hand the work to an engineer to take forward.

 Work with the product manager so that your backlog fits the roadmap, and tell them early when it does not.

 Who we’re looking for
 You have owned a team’s backlog. You decided what was built next and what was not, you accepted the work, and you can say what you decided and why.

 You have told a customer no, or changed what they asked for. You can say what they wanted, what you said and what happened next.

 You find out what customers need before building. You can show us a time you did discovery and what it changed.

 You turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices with precise acceptance criteria. You can show us a time you did it, how you knew you had it right, and what you got wrong.

 You build working front-end prototypes or small features with AI tools, in the last 12 months, and an engineer took them forward. You can say what you built and what the engineer changed.

 You check what AI tools produce. You can describe a time the output was wrong and how you caught it.

 You work well with engineers: you hand work over clearly and accept the finished work against what you agreed.

 Knowledge of parking or of any one industry is welcome, but none of it is required.

 What We Offer
 Hybrid working, 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.

 Real ownership of a team’s backlog and its customer conversations, with a product manager alongside you.

 A small team and real influence over what we build.

 A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

 A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. 

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. 

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

 Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

 Engine is where Juno meets the user. It owns the conversation itself: how someone expresses a vague intent, how the assistant narrows it down, and how a recommendation is presented so that it is actually trusted. Nobody has settled what a great shopping conversation looks like, so there are no patterns to borrow and the answers have to be found by building and testing.

jobs.description:
LE CONTEXTE : 
 Fondée en 2017 par des ingénieurs de CentraleSupélec, ILLUIN Technology est une scale-up française en pleine effervescence de plus de 200 passionnés.

 MAKE : Des réalisations tech sur-mesure en GenAI, Data Science et Software Engineering.

Véritable "Leader de terrain", vous mènerez de front plusieurs projets complexes engagés au forfait dans un univers Data / IA stimulant, tout en devenant l’artisan de l'industrialisation de nos processus internes.
 Le match parfait : Vous disposez de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience, dont au moins 5 ans passés à piloter des projets au forfait au sein d'une ESN, le tout porté par une solide culture Data / IA.
 
 VOS MISSIONS : 
 1. Chef d'Orchestre des Projets au Forfait (Engagement de résultats)

 Garant des engagements : Vous veillez au respect strict des KPI et SLA contractuels.

 Gouvernance de haut niveau : Vous êtes l'interlocuteur direct des décideurs chez nos Grands Comptes. Vous préparez et animez les Comités de Pilotage et de Suivi avec une posture de conseiller stratégique.

 2. Business Development & Animation 
 Partenaire du Business : Vous soutenez l'équipe BizDev grâce à votre vision 360° des écosystèmes clients (besoins, roadmap, contraintes).

 Croissance organique : Vous détectez de nouvelles opportunités de business au sein de vos comptes existants.

 Alignement stratégique : En binôme avec les Sales, vous veillez au cadrage des dispositifs pour maximiser la satisfaction client et la performance des équipes.

 3. Industrialisation du Delivery 
 Process & Outils : Vous structurez les backlogs, optimisez les workflows de delivery dans Jira et automatisez les reportings pour faire gagner tout le monde en efficacité.

 Amélioration continue : En collaboration avec les Delivery Managers, vous participez activement à la transformation et à l'industrialisation du Delivery au sein du SI d'Illuin (processus, intégration d'outils corporate, KPIs internes).

 
 VOTRE PROFIL
 Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur (Bac+5) issu d’une école de premier rang.

 Expérience : Plus de 7 ans d'expérience minimum, impérativement marquée par la gestion de projets au forfait dans le monde des ESN ou des cabinets de conseil.

 Hard Skills : 
 Un background technique solide (Java, Python, SQL) pour pouvoir challenger intelligemment les équipes tech.

 Une maîtrise avancée et incontournable de Jira .

 Une expertise éprouvée en gestion de projet (Agile, Cycle en V, SAFE, gestion des risques).

 Une vraie sensibilité et une culture affûtée des écosystèmes Data & IA.

 
 Soft Skills : 
 Une grande autonomie et un fort pouvoir de conviction.

 Un caméléon de la communication : vous êtes aussi à l'aise pour échanger avec un développeur en interne qu'avec le C-Level d'un grand compte.

 Un esprit de synthèse aiguisé, une excellente communication écrite/orale et une vraie posture de consultant.

 
 Langues : Français et Anglais courants (contexte international).

 LES INFOS À CONNAÎTRE

 Déplacements : Ponctuels en province pour aller à la rencontre de nos clients.

 Rémunération : Package attractif (Fixe + Variable).

 Les + : Matériel Mac dernier cri, organisation flexible et surtout, une aventure humaine et technologique hors norme.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Apaleo and the role

 Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

 At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

 Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

 This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

 What you'll be up to

 
 Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.

 Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.

 Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.

 Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.

 Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.

 Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones.

 Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.

 Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.

 Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.

 Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.

 Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

 
 What you'll bring

 You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

 Required experience and competencies 

 
 Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.

 Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.

 Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.

 Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.

 Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.

 Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.

 An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.

 Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

 
 Nice to have 

 
 Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.

 Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.

 Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.

 Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Finanzierung & Integrationen (m/w/d)

Die meisten Product-Rollen geben dir ein Backlog und ein Engineering-Team. Diese gibt dir zusätzlich einen Verhandlungstisch: Du überzeugst die Produktteams von Banken, ihr eigenes Engineering-Budget in eine Anbindung zu stecken. Danach gehört dir die Schnittstelle – auch nach dem Go-live.

 

Standort: Zentral in Berlin – Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro, hybrid mit 3 Tagen Office und 2 Tagen Homeoffice.

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

 

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Anbindung unserer Finanzierungs- und Bankpartner – von der Anforderung über die Umsetzung mit Engineering bis zum Betrieb nach dem Go-live.
  • Du überzeugst die Produktteams unserer Partner, eigenes Engineering-Budget in die Integration zu investieren, und führst diese Gespräche bis zur Entscheidung.
  • Du analysierst, wo Händler zwischen Fahrzeugansicht und abgeschlossenem Gebot abspringen, und erhöhst die Conversion messbar.
  • Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, begründest jede Priorisierung damit und verfolgst die KPIs deiner Features nach dem Launch.
  • Du baust Prototypen, um eine Idee zu testen, bevor du Engineering-Zeit dafür einplanst.
  • Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Händlern, sammelst Feedback strukturiert ein und übersetzt es in konkrete Anforderungen.

 

Die Stelle ist eine Nachbesetzung in einer gewachsenen Produktorganisation – acht Product Manager, zehn Engineering-Teams.

Was du mitbringst

  • 3–6 Jahre im Produktmanagement in einem digitalen B2B-, Plattform- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, mit breitem Verantwortungsbereich
  • Du hast eine Funnel- oder Conversion-Kennzahl bewegt und kannst Ausgangswert und Ergebnis nennen – mit Daten, die du selbst gezogen hast
  • Erfahrung mit externen Partnern, deren Prioritäten du verstehen und beeinflussen musstest – nicht nur interne Stakeholder
  • Technisches Verständnis für API-Integrationen: Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln, aber verstehen, worüber Engineering spricht
  • Eine klare Vorstellung davon, wo KI diese Arbeit konkret besser macht – ob dein aktueller Arbeitgeber dir die Tools zur Verfügung stellt, spielt für uns keine Rolle
  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher

 

Von Vorteil

 

  • Erfahrung mit einer zweiseitigen Plattform – du hast für Angebot und Nachfrage gearbeitet, nicht nur für eine Seite
  • Erfahrung mit Checkout-, Payment- oder Finanzierungsprozessen (z. B. BNPL)
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit dem Automotive-Umfeld

 

Was du nicht brauchst: Erfahrung im Banking oder Fintech. Die Finanzierungswelt lernst du hier – das Gespür für Partner bringst du mit.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 Tage Office, 2 Tage Homeoffice – plus 10 Tage „Work from Anywhere" pro Jahr
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • 2× jährliches Karriere- & Entwicklungsgespräch
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • Bezahltes Deutschlandticket
  • FitX-Mitgliedschaft oder Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss
  • Virtual Stock Options – du beteiligst dich am Erfolg
  • Moderne IT-Ausstattung für dein tägliches Arbeiten
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Buddy-Programm und Social Events
  • Gelebte Vielfalt: aktives Frauennetzwerk, Meditations- & Gebetsraum

 

Der Prozess: drei Gespräche, rund 2,5 Stunden. Kein Case-Study-Paket für zu Hause – die Aufgabe lösen wir gemeinsam im Raum.

 

Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.

jobs.title: Product Manager Digital Platforms
jobs.description:
🌊 Who are we? 
 
We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.
 
 About the role
 AURA is the platform Aquablu runs on. It replaced about 15 tools with one system of record, gives every colleague their own AI agent, and connects to hundreds of our systems in the field. Version 2.0 just went live. What it becomes next is your call.
 
 You own AURA’s direction: what gets built, why, and in what order. Then you build it yourself. You’ll write features with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and deploy them to production. Our engineering team sets the architecture, reviews your work, and makes sure the platform stays safe while you move fast.
 
 You don’t need to have been an engineer. You do need to want to ship code. You’ll report to our Head of Digital Product.
